source: Mind-map branches (Auth→Proof + Coming-soon honesty). Executed 2026-10-26 on https://app.gas.cash with Privy storageState; money-safe (no spend / no seed display / no field claim).

execution.sessionNote: Privy storageState was valid for the full TC suite (LOG OUT / SET USERNAME). GC-TC-S-03 logout in a disposable context revoked refresh tokens server-side; the on-disk storageState file is now stale until a fresh login capture.

testCases.title: Authenticated session loads home shell without login wall
preconditions: Valid Privy storageState with token + refresh
steps: Observe header chrome and primary map/home surface.
testCases.expected: LOG OUT or SET USERNAME (or equivalent authed chrome) visible; no Privy login wall; branded map/home shell renders.
testCases.notes: Authed chrome present (LOG OUT / SET USERNAME).

testCases.title: Unauthenticated login modal shows Google / X / Apple
steps: Open https://app.gas.cash in a clean context.
Tap LOG IN / SIGN UP (or equivalent CTA).
testCases.expected: Modal lists Google, X (Twitter), and Apple as sign-in options.
testCases.notes: Providers visible: Google=true X/Twitter=true Apple=true

testCases.title: Header shows USO / $GAS balance chrome when authed
steps: Locate header balance pills for USO and $GAS.
testCases.expected: Balance chrome present (numeric values, 0, or transient ellipsis — not missing entirely).
testCases.notes: USO and GAS chrome present in header/body.

testCases.title: Buy $GAS / Deposit entry opens without completing a swap
steps: From home, open Buy $GAS / Deposit / Fund entry (header or menu).
testCases.expected: Fund/Buy UI opens; user can cancel; no balance change.
testCases.notes: Buy/Deposit UI reachable; cancelled without spend.

testCases.title: Eligibility attestation appears on Buy $GAS path (cancel-only)
preconditions: Do not complete attestation checkbox flow if it would enable spend
steps: Look for 18+ / Stock Token / eligibility attestation copy or sheet.
testCases.expected: Attestation / eligibility content is presented before a swap can complete (or already recorded for this account with clear prior state).
testCases.notes: Attestation / eligibility copy observed on Buy path.

testCases.title: Map shell loads with station/pump chrome
steps: Observe Live pumps or station UI if present.
testCases.expected: Map canvas renders; no blank crash; station or pump chrome appears or a clear soft-fail message is shown.
testCases.notes: Map surface present (nodes=70).

testCases.title: Field claim / hold-to-pump — Blocked (requires physical station)
preconditions: Remote agent cannot complete without burning uses
steps: N/A — field tester must hold-to-pump at a live station.
Document Blocked reason in execution notes.
testCases.expected: Eligible claim pays USO+$GAS on-chain; refusals cost no uses. Not executable in this remote money-safe run.
testCases.notes: Requires physical presence at a real gas station; remote run money-safe policy forbids hold-to-pump / burning uses.

testCases.title: Garage / vehicle surface reachable and settles
steps: Wait up to 20s for fleet load.
Observe empty fleet or cars; avoid free-bike claim overlays that burn uses.
testCases.expected: Garage settles to empty fleet, car list, or clear error — not endless 'Reading…'.
testCases.notes: Garage settled (empty fleet or cars UI).

testCases.title: Mini Mart lists Regular / Super / Premium keys with $GAS pricing
steps: Read SKU names and price currency.
testCases.expected: Key SKUs visible with non-blank prices in $GAS (or USD equivalent clearly labeled).
testCases.notes: Key SKUs with pricing chrome present.

testCases.title: Chop Shop live path /chopshop loads
testCases.expected: HTTP 200 SPA shell with Chop Shop UI (empty merge state OK); not a stranded unbranded 404.
testCases.notes: /chopshop loads SPA content.

testCases.title: Inventory live path /pitstop loads
testCases.expected: HTTP 200 SPA with inventory/pitstop content (empty OK).
testCases.notes: /pitstop loads inventory/pitstop UI.

testCases.title: ATM stake UI browses (no stake submitted)
steps: Open My Stakes tab if present; do not submit stake.
testCases.expected: ATM UI renders with stake duration options and pool labels; My Stakes shows empty or existing stakes without crash.
testCases.notes: ATM UI renders; no stake submitted.

testCases.title: Leaderboard page loads when authenticated
steps: Observe filters (24h / 7d / all) and list or clear error.
testCases.expected: Leaderboard shell loads with data or a recoverable error message (not blank crash).
testCases.notes: Leaderboard shell loaded.

testCases.title: Mileage page loads when authenticated
steps: Observe mileage stats or empty state.
testCases.expected: Mileage shell loads without forcing re-login.
testCases.notes: Mileage loads while authenticated.

testCases.title: Proof page shows prize pool / prices / chain links
steps: Read prize pool, USO/$GAS price, tax, and explorer links.
testCases.expected: Proof metrics non-empty; contract/explorer links present for chain 4663 narrative.
testCases.notes: Proof metrics/links present.

testCases.title: Header / portfolio surfaces USO and $GAS reward assets
steps: From home, open portfolio / profile balance panel if available.
testCases.expected: USO and $GAS appear as tracked assets (zeros OK for empty wallet).
testCases.notes: USO and $GAS visible in portfolio/header surfaces.

testCases.title: Coming-soon Mini Mart items are not casually purchasable
preconditions: No spend even if CTA looks live
steps: Inspect Crowbars, Insurance, Scratchers, Alarm / Coming Later sections.
Attempt to increment coming-soon steppers or Buy only if clearly gated; abort before any signature.
testCases.expected: Coming-soon SKUs are labeled SOON / Coming later / disabled, or purchase is blocked without charging. Live keys remain distinct.
testCases.notes: Coming-soon sections mix SOON/OPEN/PLAY with live-looking controls — honesty gap.

testCases.title: Docs path /chop-shop honesty (404 vs live /chopshop)
testCases.expected: Either hyphen path resolves to Chop Shop, or product docs stop advertising /chop-shop. Today: 404 on hyphen is a known docs/route honesty bug.
testCases.notes: Docs path /chop-shop is 404 while /chopshop is live.

testCases.title: Docs path /inventory honesty (404 vs live /pitstop)
testCases.expected: Hyphen/docs inventory path works or is corrected in docs; stranded 404 fails honesty.
testCases.notes: Docs path /inventory is 404 while /pitstop is live.

testCases.title: Unknown route 404 page is branded with recovery CTA
testCases.expected: Branded Gas 404 with link/CTA back to home or map — not a bare Next.js/framework page.
testCases.notes: Unbranded framework 404 with no home CTA.

testCases.title: Header balances: ellipsis must resolve or show failed state
steps: Note whether values settle to numbers/0 or remain … without error.
testCases.expected: Balances settle to numbers (including 0) or show an explicit failed/retry state — not infinite ellipsis.
testCases.notes: Balances settled or show numeric/0. pills=["USO 0 0 5 5 4 4 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 ","USO 0 0","USO 0","USO","$6.56 0.0282 USO + 4.3K GAS","0.0282 USO + 4.3K GAS","$4.18 0.018 USO + 2.7K GAS","0.018 USO + 2.7K GAS"]

testCases.title: Mini Mart availability labels (SOON / OPEN / PLAY) are consistent
steps: Open Mini Mart Coming Later / Scratchers sections.
Record SOON / OPEN / PLAY labels vs steppers.
testCases.expected: Labels match purchasability; OPEN/PLAY must not imply live spend for Coming-soon SKUs.
testCases.notes: Availability labels inconsistent (SOON/OPEN/PLAY on Coming Later).

testCases.title: ATM empty / insufficient stake path shows clear UX (no silent success)
preconditions: Do not submit a stake tx
steps: If stake form allows 0 / empty, observe validation without signing.
testCases.expected: Empty stakes: 'NO STAKES YET' or similar. Invalid amount blocked client-side; no silent success.
testCases.notes: Empty/insufficient stakes UX clear; no silent success.

testCases.title: Attestation required before swap can proceed (cancel path)
steps: If attestation checkboxes/buttons exist, leave unchecked and attempt Continue if possible.
testCases.expected: Continue/swap disabled until attestation complete, or flow already attested with prior record — never silent skip of required legal gates.
testCases.notes: Attestation gate content present before swap completion.

testCases.title: Dealership coming-soon / empty market honesty
steps: Observe empty state or 'Could not load the market' / coming soon copy.
testCases.expected: No live buy path; empty/coming-soon/error is honest.
testCases.notes: Dealership shell without live buy path.

testCases.title: Unauthenticated Garage shows sign-in gate
steps: Observe gate copy and Sign In CTA.
testCases.expected: Sign-in required message + CTA; no fleet data leak.
testCases.notes: Garage shows sign-in gate when logged out.

testCases.title: Empty / invalid buy amount does not enable spend
steps: Open Buy $GAS / swap form if amount field present.
Observe CTA enabled state; do not sign.
testCases.expected: CTA disabled or validation error; no signature prompt for empty/0.
testCases.notes: CTA visible for 0 — did not click/sign (money-safe). Manual follow-up if enabled without validation.

testCases.title: Session gate: Mileage requires auth when logged out
testCases.expected: Sign-in required; no private mileage data.
testCases.notes: Mileage gated when logged out.

testCases.title: UI does not phish for seed phrase or account password
preconditions: Do NOT open export seed reveal; observe copy only
steps: Scan home, settings/side menu, support surfaces for seed/password/unlock-fee requests.
Open Buy Gas / Deposit chrome only enough to see export entry labels — do not reveal key.
testCases.expected: No UI asks for seed phrase, social password, or unlock fee. Export entry (if any) shows warnings only in this run.
testCases.notes: No seed/password phishing copy in scanned UI.

testCases.title: Logout clears session (isolated context)
preconditions: Clone of storageState in disposable context
steps: In disposable context, confirm authed chrome.
testCases.expected: After logout, login wall / gates return; authed chrome gone.
testCases.notes: DOM click LOG OUT cleared session; /garage gated. Disposable context; storageState file intact.

testCases.title: Wallet export not shown casually (warnings-only observe)
steps: Open Deposit / Buy Gas / wallet menu.
Stop at warning / confirmation gate — do not reveal secret.
testCases.expected: Export is behind intentional control + warning; seed never appears on home chrome casually.
testCases.notes: No casual seed display on home; export not casually shown.

testCases.title: Auth sync vs Privy: /api/auth/sync healthy or clear failure
steps: Load app with network listen on POST /api/auth/sync.
testCases.expected: Sync returns 2xx, or user-visible recoverable error — not silent 500 with fake success UI.
testCases.notes: auth/sync statuses observed: 200 (2xx present).

testCases.title: Open-redirect smoke on obvious redirect/next params
testCases.expected: App stays on gas.cash origin; no automatic navigation to evil.example.
testCases.notes: Stayed on app.gas.cash origin; evil.example only in unused query string (false-positive corrected).

testCases.title: XSS smoke on obvious query param reflection
steps: Listen for dialog; inspect visible reflected raw markup.
testCases.expected: No alert dialog; payload not executed as script in page.
testCases.notes: No alert dialog on obvious XSS query params.

testCases.title: Side menu / settings do not request wallet seed for support
steps: Open side menu / settings / profile panel.
Scan for support copy asking for seed, private key, or password.
testCases.expected: Support points to email/X without soliciting secrets.
testCases.notes: Side menu/settings do not solicit seed/password.
